finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs hid in the warning noise, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Read `options.retries`, bundler now sends `retryCount` | Read `retryCount`, fall back to `retries` |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Threw on `undefined` flag, loader no longer sends `false` | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 remaining warnings are real noise. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here.

Next: nothing. Build exits 0.
